vc_checking.summary: All three cleaned manual VCs are semantically provable from the current annotation and existing xizi singly-linked-list library. No annotation/spec rework or new helper declaration is required. The minimum valid plan is one dependency-free group covering the initialization, loop-step, and return witnesses in manual order.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Branch 1 has xizi_sll_head linklist_pre l ** xizi_sll_node linklist_node_pre. Branch 2 has xizi_sll q l.
vc_shape.pre_pure: Unfolding branch-1 predicates yields linklist_pre <> 0 and linklist_node_pre <> 0; branch 2 receives those facts as PreH1/PreH2.
vc_shape.pre_exists: Unfolding xizi_sll_head exposes the successor stored in linklist_pre.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The head next-field cell, an empty self-segment, the unchanged suffix list, and the fresh node's undefined next-field cell; branch 2 preserves xizi_sll q l.
vc_shape.post_pure: The empty-prefix list equation and the repeated non-null facts.
vc_shape.post_exists: Branch 1 requires next, l1a, l1b; branch 2 requires l1b.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Branch 1 chooses next as the successor exposed by xizi_sll_head, l1a := nil, and l1b := l. Branch 2 chooses l1b := l.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold xizi_sll_head/generic_sll_head, xizi_head_store/sll_head_store/sll_link, xizi_sll_node, and xizi_sllseg. The self-segment with nil reduces to emp; the suffix and fresh-node cell frame directly.
witnesses.pure_plan: Predicate conjuncts discharge every non-null goal. The equation linklist_pre :: l = nil ++ linklist_pre :: l simplifies reflexively.
premise_discharge: all list equations are definitional simplifications after the chosen witnesses
witnesses.grouping_reason: Initializes the same traversal invariant used by the next two obligations.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: A node -> next_2 field, xizi_sllseg linklist_pre node l1a_2, xizi_sll next_2 l1b_2, and the fresh node's undefined field; the second branch already exposes xizi_sll q l0 instead of the whole suffix.
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH1/PreH2.. supply the old list decomposition and all non-null conditions; the second branch also supplies l1b_2 = next_2 :: l0.
vc_shape.pre_exists: xizi_sll_not_zero exposes next_2's successor and suffix list in the first branch.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The traversal segment is extended from node through next_2, followed by the remaining xizi_sll suffix; the fresh-node cell is framed.
vc_shape.post_pure: The list decomposition is shifted one node to next_2 and the non-null facts are preserved.
vc_shape.post_exists: First branch requires next, l1a, l1b; second branch requires l1a, l1b.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: First branch: after l1b_2 = next_2 :: lnext, choose next := successor(next_2), l1a := l1a_2 ++ [node], l1b := lnext. Second branch: choose l1a := l1a_2 ++ [node], l1b := l0.
witnesses.space_plan: Use xizi_sll_not_zero under next_2 <> 0; turn node -> next_2 into xizi_sllseg node next_2 [node] via xizi_sllseg_len1 using node <> 0; compose with xizi_sllseg_sllseg and frame the remaining suffix/fresh-node field.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH2 discharges the singleton-segment premise and PreH6/PreH7 discharges suffix decomposition. Substitute the suffix equation, rewrite app_assoc, simplify, and finish from PreH1.
premise_discharge: xizi_sll_not_zero premise next_2 <> NULL is PreH6 in branch 1
xizi_sllseg_len1 premise node <> NULL is PreH2/PreH3
segment composition has no extra pure premise
the shifted list equation follows from PreH1 and the exposed suffix equation by app_assoc
witnesses.grouping_reason: Core loop transition of the same segment-extension proof family.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: node -> linklist_node_pre, xizi_sllseg linklist_pre node l1a, xizi_sll next l1b with next = 0, and linklist_node_pre -> 0.
vc_shape.pre_pure: PreH1 gives linklist_pre :: l = l1a ++ node :: l1b; PreH2..PreH6 provide node/root/new-node non-nullness and next = 0.
vc_shape.pre_exists: Decomposing the rebuilt non-null whole list exposes the root's stored successor q and logical tail l0.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Either xizi_sll_head linklist_pre (l ++ [linklist_node_pre]) or its explicitly unfolded existential q form.
vc_shape.post_pure: Root non-nullness plus equality of the rebuilt logical tail to l ++ [linklist_node_pre].
vc_shape.post_exists: The explicit branch chooses q as linklist_pre's successor.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Use q and l0 exposed by xizi_sll_not_zero after rebuilding the complete list, then prove l0 = l ++ [linklist_node_pre].
witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_sll_zero using next = 0 to get l1b = nil. Build xizi_sll linklist_node_pre [linklist_node_pre] using xizi_sll_len1, prepend node using xizi_sll_cons, combine with the prefix using xizi_sllseg_sll, derive root non-nullness with xizi_sllseg_start_not_zero, and expose the head with xizi_sll_not_zero/unfolding xizi_sll_head.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH2 discharges node non-nullness, PreH3/PreH4 discharges new-node non-nullness, and PreH5/root or xizi_sllseg_start_not_zero discharges root non-nullness. Substitute next and l1b; combine PreH1 with the rebuilt-list decomposition using app_assoc and constructor injectivity to identify the target tail.
premise_discharge: xizi_sll_zero premise next = NULL is PreH6
xizi_sll_len1 premises linklist_node_pre <> NULL and 0 = NULL are PreH3/PreH4 and reflexivity
xizi_sll_cons premise node <> NULL is PreH2
xizi_sllseg_start_not_zero premise node <> NULL is PreH2
xizi_sll_not_zero premise linklist_pre <> NULL is PreH5 or the derived segment fact
the final tail equality follows from PreH1, l1b = nil, app_assoc, and list-constructor injectivity
witnesses.grouping_reason: Consumes the same traversal segment and list-decomposition invariant to finish append.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Expose or rebuild xizi_sll nodes, extend/compose xizi_sllseg, and solve list equations from the traversal invariant.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use the existing xizi_sll decomposition/construction and segment-composition lemmas.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Discharge non-null premises directly from VC hypotheses and normalize app/cons equations.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, invariant, predicate family, and sequential proof context; 3 witnesses is below the group limit of 12.

proof_groups.grouping_reason: All three obligations are the ordered initialization, loop-step, and return phases of the same singly-linked-list append invariant. They use one coherent xizi_sll/xizi_sllseg lemma family, total only 3 witnesses (within the limit of 12), and can be proved sequentially by one worker without cross-group helpers; a single group is therefore the minimum valid grouping.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove initialization by unfolding head/node predicates and choosing the empty prefix; prove loop-step by suffix decomposition and one-node segment extension; prove return by null-suffix elimination, singleton construction, segment/list composition, and head rebuilding.

required_forbidden_lemma_scan.on_match: reject group result and rework the affected proof before parent verification
